# Historical exterior source bytes

These four text fixtures are the exact exterior renderer sources from `be019fdef706cc7ea3210db3ecbb69ce2242f549`, before the resident's eight-photo refinement.

The earlier White, Green and merged-layout preservation receipts refer to these bytes. Their recorded hashes are retained and checked against this archive. Current source coordinates, interior data and floorplans continue to be checked directly; current exterior behavior is covered by the facade, photographic-detail, presentation and picking tests.

These files are archival text, not imported by the application or used to regenerate layouts.
